name: FSCO Instant Shop
author: Frame & Shadow Co.

sections.description:
FSCO Instant Shop is a fast, AJAX-powered product loader and grid for WooCommerce and Elementor. It enables an interactive and highly responsive product grid for your WooCommerce shop, with various sorting and filtering options.

Key features include:
* Lightning-fast AJAX product loading for a smoother shopping experience
* Responsive grid view for all devices
* Category filter with sidebar and dropdown options (category filter dropdown on mobile)
* Product sorting options: Sort by date, price, popularity, etc.
* Products per page selector
* Pagination with AJAX for seamless browsing
* Elementor compatibility: Easily customizable through Elementor controls
* Theme compatibility: Works with any WordPress theme

FSCO Instant Shop enhances the user experience by loading products quickly and efficiently, offering a seamless browsing experience on any device.

Support

For support, please contact Frame & Shadow Co. at development@frameandshadow.co or open an issue on the plugin repository at GitHub.
For premium support and to purchase the full version, visit https://www.frameandshadow.co.

Licensing

FSCO Instant Shop is a commercial plugin. You can use it for free, but to unlock the pro-features, you need a valid license key. For more information, or to purchase a license for the pro version, visit our website: https://www.frameandshadow.co.
sections.installation:
1. Standard Installation (Manual Upload)

  1. Download the plugin zip file from your purchase page or plugin repository.
  2. Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click on the Upload Plugin button at the top.
  5. Choose the fsco-instant-shop.zip file from your computer and click Install Now.
  6. After installation, click Activate to activate the plugin.

2. Installation via WordPress Dashboard

  1. In your WordPress Admin, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for FSCO Instant Shop in the search bar.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.

3. Activating the Pro Version (Commercial License)

The pro version of FSCO Instant Shop unlocks additional features and premium support. To activate the Pro Version of the plugin:

  1. Purchase the FSCO Instant Shop Pro plugin from https://www.frameandshadow.co.
  2. After purchasing, you’ll receive a license key along with a link to download the pro plugin zip file.
  3. Install the Pro plugin zip file as a new plugin:
    • Go to Plugins > Add New and click Upload Plugin.
    • Upload the FSCO Instant Shop Pro.zip file.
    • Activate the Pro version.
  4. Once activated, navigate to Settings > FSCO Instant Shop Pro in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  5. Enter your license key in the provided field and click Save Changes to activate the pro features.
  6. The plugin will now be fully activated, and you’ll have access to all premium features, including automatic updates and premium support.

4. Adding the Widget to Elementor

  1. After activating the plugin, go to your Elementor page editor.
  2. Search for the “FSCO AJAX Products” widget in the Elementor sidebar.
  3. Drag and drop the widget to your page where you want the product grid to appear.
  4. Customize the widget settings via the Elementor editor: You can adjust product display settings, sorting options, grid layout, and more.
  5. Once you’re happy with the layout, click Publish or Update to save your changes.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, FSCO Instant Shop requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated in order to work.

Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, this plugin requires Elementor to use the “FSCO AJAX Products” widget.

Can I use this plugin with any theme?

Yes, FSCO Instant Shop is designed to work with any WordPress theme that is compatible with Elementor and WooCommerce.

How do I customize the grid columns?

The grid columns are responsive by default, and you can control them through the Elementor settings. For advanced control over the grid layout, use custom CSS. See the plugin documentation for more details.

Is the plugin compatible with mobile devices?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and provides a mobile-friendly category filter dropdown and grid layout.

Where can I buy the full version of the plugin?

The full version of FSCO Instant Shop, with additional features and premium support, is available for purchase at https://www.frameandshadow.co.
